children: Featuring adorable Cheeries™ play figures, vehicles, and a portable foldable format, this modular collection combines purposeful play and discovery, letting kids explore wherever they go
WILTON, Conn., Aug. 31, 2026 /CNW/ -- Melissa & Doug®, the #1 preschool brand for wooden and sustainable toys*, announced today the national launch of

a modular pretend world made of wood and mixed materials that reimagines the traditional dollhouse/play set with an open-top design that makes imaginative storytelling easier and more engaging for toddlers and preschoolers. The collection's initial pre-launch inventory sold out rapidly during an early release window, signaling strong consumer demand and setting the stage for a highly anticipated national rollout.
Recognizing an opportunity to elevate traditional play figure sets, Melissa & Doug designed its

collection around how children as young as 2 years old naturally play. Created specifically for little hands, its thoughtful, open-access design makes every space easy to reach, removing barriers to exploration and fostering uninterrupted storytelling. As children create their own layouts and act out relatable real-world scenarios with the articulated play figures that can sit or stand, they engage in play that helps support imagination, curiosity, confidence, fine motor skills, and social-emotional development.

"We're giving kids a new perspective on play—a play-from-above experience," said Lauren DeFeo Duchene, President of Melissa & Doug and EVP at Spin Master. "Through observing children at play, our designers noticed that toddlers sometimes find it challenging to maneuver play figures and furniture in traditional, open-front dollhouses or play set. To solve this, we designed

for little hands with a flexible, open-top layout to make it easier for kids to reach down, in, and around as they play from every angle. At Melissa & Doug, we believe that when toys are designed with intention, they open the door to purposeful play and discovery—helping kids build confidence and skills for the real world."
collection is intentionally designed to appeal to both girls and boys. Highlights include:
With an open-top design and flexible, modular layout, kids can play from above—with a clear, unobstructed view.
Kids can set the scene their way by designing the layout, arranging the pieces, and posing the articulated play figures to sit or stand.
With a clever foldable design, built-in handle, and room for storage, this play set is ready for adventure whenever—and wherever—you are.
Wooden charm, fun textures to touch, and delightful designs all provide a rich sensory experience to inspire curiosity and discovery.
